feeds.title: Fellowship of European Evangelical Theologians
feeds.description: The Fellowship of European Evangelical Theologians (FEET) is a network of theological scholars. The purpose of FEET is the advancement of the Christian religion in Europe through the promotion and encouragement of the study of Evangelical Christian Theology in a spirit of loyalty to the Bible.

feeds.title: Micheala Y Goba Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to my blog. My name is Micheala Yema Goba, and I am a Christian Youth. I blog about Spiritual growth, Christian living, and more. As a youth, I am also growing and learning how to live this Christ-life we've all been called to live. I am here to share with you my experience and all that I'm learning.

feeds.title: Bishop in Europe
feeds.description: The Bishop in Europe is the ordinary of the Church of England's Diocese in Europe in the Province of Canterbury.

feeds.title: The Bible and Culture
feeds.description: A One-Stop Shop for All Things Biblical and Christian.

feeds.title: Man in the Mirror Blog
feeds.description: The blog has a collection of articles to take Christian men beyond 'men's ministry' and into discipleship relationships that transform men, their families, their communities, and the world. Man in the Mirror is working with churches and millions of men to see every man reflect honestly, pursue God wholeheartedly, and live vibrantly. The mission of Man in the Mirror is to equip Christian men around the world to engage in meaningful relationships that change lives and build the kingdom of God.

feeds.title: Exploring Faith in Europe
feeds.description: 'Exploring Faith in Europe' is a blog that explores various aspects of faith, spirituality, and religious practices in the European context. While not solely focused on the lectionary, the blog may occasionally feature reflections or discussions related to the lectionary readings. Readers can expect explorations of European religious traditions, pilgrimage experiences, and insights into diverse expressions of faith in Europe.

feeds.title: Bibles for Europe Blog
feeds.description: Enjoy posts on the Christian life and the Bible. Bibles for Europe (BFE) is a registered charity dedicated to giving away free copies of the New Testament Recovery Version study Bible in Europe. Our mission is to provide free Bible to everyone and encourage faith. We're believers in the Lord Jesus Christ and we love the Bible.

feeds.title: European Christian Environmental Network
feeds.description: European Christian Environmental Network (ECEN) is a church network promoting cooperation, action, and theological reflection in caring for God's creation. The ECEN aims to share information, and experiences in environmental work among widely varied Christian traditions and to encourage a united witness in caring for God's creation.
